STORIES.headline: Hackers breach US Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform
STORIES.summary: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force’s Cloud One cloud platform, potentially exposing sensitive tactical, personnel, and logistics data.
article: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force’s Cloud One cloud platform, potentially exposing sensitive tactical, personnel, and logistics data. The breach was uncovered recently during a system upgrade and has caused widespread disruption across the platform. The identity of the hackers, the extent of the intrusion, and data theft remain unknown. The Air Force declined to comment on the security status or vulnerabilities of the Cloud One system.

US Air Force’s Cloud One platform has been compromised by hackers, according to sources familiar with the matter, raising concerns over sensitive data exposure. The breach was detected during a recent system upgrade and has disrupted operations across the platform. Details about the hackers, the breach’s scope, and data loss remain unconfirmed. The Air Force stated it does not comment on the security or operational status of specific systems.
STORIES.imageAlt: Hackers breach US Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform

STORIES.headline: Parts of the US clean up, power outages being restored after Thanksgiving storm soaks East Coast
STORIES.summary: Heavy rain over flooded East Coast communities eased Friday, with power slowly restored to hundreds of thousands as high-tide flooding threats remained.
article: Heavy rain over flooded East Coast communities eased Friday, with power slowly restored to hundreds of thousands as high-tide flooding threats remained. Holiday storms disrupted travel, toppled trees and power lines, and prompted water rescues from New York to Virginia.

The storms disrupted travel, downed trees and power lines, and triggered water rescues from New York to Virginia. Cold rain affected the Midwest, Ohio Valley, and Lower Great Lakes, while a separate storm in the Northwest brought rain to coastal Oregon.

STORIES.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed for the first time in its history
STORIES.summary: The event will be rescheduled to Saturday, with Mayor Zohran Mamdani confirming the decision was made jointly with Macy's and city agencies.
article: The event will be rescheduled to Saturday, with Mayor Zohran Mamdani confirming the decision was made jointly with Macy's and city agencies.

Macy's confirmed the parade's first-ever postponement in its history, announced Wednesday. A looming nor'easter has forced the cancellation of the planned record 100 inflatables, with safety being the top priority. Macy's cited safety concerns and consulted with city partners before deciding to move the parade, as stated to NBC. Macy's thanked volunteers, performers, and partners for their contributions to the annual event.
STORIES.imageAlt: Split screen. Left, Tom Turkey float is seen. Right, man reacting to parade being cancelled.

STORIES.headline: UK DWP shuts down online services amid cyber incident
STORIES.summary: On Friday morning, the DWP announced a precautionary shutdown of certain online services after identifying a cyber incident impacting its systems.
article: On Friday morning, the DWP announced a precautionary shutdown of certain online services after identifying a cyber incident impacting its systems. The DWP is collaborating with the National Cyber Security Centre and GC3 to investigate the cyber incident and restore services swiftly. Benefit and pension payments continue as scheduled, and users are advised to retry accessing services later.

Individuals attempting to verify their state pension or apply for disability benefits or universal credit were unable to do so on Friday morning. DWP officials confirm that financial payments will continue to be processed normally despite the system outage.
STORIES.imageAlt: A logo reading Department for Work & Pensions

STORIES.headline: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy criticizes Donald Trump for describing Vladimir Putin as a friend
STORIES.summary: Trump called Putin 'my friend' during the meeting, a remark Zelensky condemned as dangerously similar to befriending a wartime aggressor.
article: Trump called Putin 'my friend' during the meeting, a remark Zelensky condemned as dangerously similar to befriending a wartime aggressor.

Zelenskyy criticized Trump for comparing his friendship with Putin to befriending Adolf Hitler during World War II. The Ukrainian president spoke to the BBC after Trump met Putin in China last week, highlighting the 'strange' nature of their relationship. Trump shared a photo of the meeting with a caption reading 'My friend,' which drew global outrage given Putin's ongoing attacks on Ukraine. The incident is seen as evidence that Trump may prioritize ending the war by forcing Ukraine to surrender rather than pressuring Putin to stop the invasion.
STORIES.imageAlt: Volodymyr Zelensky in a gold and blue ballroom.

STORIES.headline: Did the Iowa lead detonation impact food safety? Here’s what officials say
STORIES.summary: Post-explosion EPA testing found no toxic airborne lead above nearby farms, homes, and businesses.
article: Post-explosion EPA testing found no toxic airborne lead above nearby farms, homes, and businesses. EPA crews are now gathering soil and water samples to assess potential lead contamination. Given that Iowa farmers supply about 8% of the nation’s food, food safety concerns remain under scrutiny.

The U.S. Army has declared the detonation of its aging lead azide stockpile a success. However, criticism persists over the federal government’s communication timeline and transparency. EPA personnel conducted field sampling of schools, playgrounds, churches, and homes on Thursday. Over 1,500 samples of air, water, soil, and dust were collected prior to the detonation.

STORIES.summary: The Trump administration sought to boost oil output in Iraq and Venezuela, fearing OPEC quotas would restrict production growth.
article: The Trump administration sought to boost oil output in Iraq and Venezuela, fearing OPEC quotas would restrict production growth.

Chevron’s stock performance reflects investor concerns over potential OPEC membership changes and the company’s global exploration expansion. A Reuters report states the Trump administration blocked Venezuela from paying its annual OPEC dues and urged both nations to consider leaving the cartel. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman advised Washington against pressuring Venezuela further, while Iraq’s oil ministry persuaded Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi to stay in OPEC.

STORIES.summary: Sheinbaum emphasized that Mexico’s relationship with the U.S. is one of coordination, not subordination, in her daily briefing.
article: Sheinbaum emphasized that Mexico’s relationship with the U.S. is one of coordination, not subordination, in her daily briefing. The complaint comes amid U.S. pressure on Mexico to strengthen its anti-cartel efforts, with Trump administration officials pushing for increased cooperation. The U.S. has publicly offered to deploy troops in Mexico, a move Sheinbaum has explicitly rejected.

President Claudia Sheinbaum criticized DEA officials for their tip line, asserting it constitutes interference in Mexico’s domestic law enforcement. Sheinbaum stated that the DEA has ample domestic responsibilities and should focus on its own country, according to AP.

STORIES.headline: Iran accuses Ukraine of false flag drone attack in Kuwait to draw attention from Trump
STORIES.summary: Iran's former nuclear negotiator Mohammad Marandi claimed Ukrainian forces operate in the Middle East, supporting the theory that the Kuwait strike was a false flag orchestrated by Ukraine.
article: Iran's former nuclear negotiator Mohammad Marandi claimed Ukrainian forces operate in the Middle East, supporting the theory that the Kuwait strike was a false flag orchestrated by Ukraine.

Iran accused Ukraine of orchestrating a drone attack in Kuwait to gain favor with President Trump, asserting it was a false flag operation. Iran denied responsibility for a drone strike in Kuwait that killed two Italian defense workers and injured two others, accusing Ukraine of staging the attack to provoke U.S. attention. Mohammad Marandi, Iran’s former nuclear adviser, stated Ukrainian operatives are active in northern Iraq and Syria, supporting the claim that the Kuwait strike was a false flag.
STORIES.imageAlt: Passenger flights diverted as Kuwait army intercepts Iranian drone attack

STORIES.headline: Huw Edwards to appear in Channel 4 documentary addressing his conviction and fall from grace
STORIES.summary: Channel 4’s documentary on Huw Edwards, titled Huw Edwards – Guilty, has sparked controversy ahead of its release.
article: Channel 4’s documentary on Huw Edwards, titled Huw Edwards – Guilty, has sparked controversy ahead of its release. A trailer showing Huw Edwards confronting questions about his downfall has ignited debate over whether the platforming is appropriate. Huw Edwards exited court in September 2024, and three former BBC News sources have expressed discomfort with the documentary’s approach.

Huw Edwards will speak publicly for the first time about his 2024 conviction for indecent images of children in a Channel 4 documentary focused on his fall from grace. The documentary, Huw Edwards – Guilty, describes a 'stark exploration' of Edwards’s life following grooming allegations and a 2024 conviction with a six-month prison sentence suspended for two years.
STORIES.imageAlt: Huw Edwards in a suit and dark glasses flanked by a police officer and protesters outside a court hearing in 2024

STORIES.headline: Los Angeles schools disable Google’s AI Overviews on student devices
STORIES.summary: Los Angeles school districts have blocked Google’s AI-generated search summaries on school-issued devices, considering a full exit from Google products without a permanent AI solution.
article: Los Angeles school districts have blocked Google’s AI-generated search summaries on school-issued devices, considering a full exit from Google products without a permanent AI solution. As the largest district to remove AI Overviews, Los Angeles Unified is now the leading school system to sideline Google’s AI tools in education. The district has not officially announced the change, and the decision was made without prior public notice, according to Schools Beyond Screens LA leaders.
Google claims schools that disable AI entirely will lose access to search, prompting some districts to develop workarounds or explore alternative search engines.
STORIES.imageAlt: Los Angeles schools disable Google’s AI Overviews on student devices

STORIES.headline: UK net migration reaches lowest level in 30 years
STORIES.summary: Net migration has dropped to its lowest point in three decades, excluding pandemic years, amid a sharp decline in asylum seekers.
article: Net migration has dropped to its lowest point in three decades, excluding pandemic years, amid a sharp decline in asylum seekers. The government attributes the drop to stricter visa policies and tighter enforcement of illegal entry routes, though critics argue the situation is not as positive as claimed.

Net migration to the UK has reached its lowest level since 1997, according to new statistics released this week. Net migration is now 92% lower than its peak of 944,000 recorded in the year ending March 2023.
STORIES.imageAlt: UK net migration reaches lowest level in 30 years
